title: Hybridization of DNA Oligos
author: Laura Sánchez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8guhtww

steps.title: Reconstitute lyophilized oligos
steps.instruction: Add water to the lyophilized oligonucleotides to reach a final concentration of 100 µM, vortex for 30 seconds, then incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes to dissolve.

substeps.instruction: Add the required volume of H₂O to achieve 100 µM.

steps.title: Prepare annealing reaction mix
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube combine 45.5 µL H₂O, 2.5 µL 1.0 M NaCl, 1 µL 5'‑oligo (100 µM) and 1 µL 3'‑oligo (100 µM).

steps.title: Thermal annealing program
steps.instruction: Place the PCR tube in a thermocycler and run: 5 min at 95 °C, 1 min at 95 °C, then ramp down 1 °C per cycle for 72 cycles, finally hold at 10 °C.

substeps.instruction: Ramp down 1 °C per cycle for 72 cycles.

steps.title: Dilute annealed oligos to working concentration
steps.instruction: Take 10 µL of the annealed oligonucleotides and add 90 µL H₂O to obtain a 0.2 µM solution.

steps.title: Store annealed oligo stocks
steps.instruction: Store the annealed oligonucleotide stocks at –20 °C for future use.
